title: relay board spec
description: A relay board. Renders an optional intro, board-level blocks, then questions (each with optional per-question blocks), then a submit button. The result JSON contains "answers", "comment", per-question "notes", "annotations" (element-level comments the user attached to any block — see the annotation shape below), and "blockEdits" (a map blockId→edited source for any editable mermaid block the user changed, null when none).

version.description: Spec version. Optional: a spec without it is read as version 1.

$schema.description: Optional URL of this schema, for editor completion. Relay ignores it.

intro.description: Intro text shown under the title. Newlines preserved.

blocks.description: Rich content blocks rendered in order. Board-level blocks show above the questions; per-question blocks show above the control. Each is annotatable (element-level comments returned in result.annotations).

md.description: markdown: built-in mini renderer (no external library) — headings, lists, code, quotes, links, images, and GFM pipe tables. Text selections are commentable. For real tabular data prefer a "table" block (sortable + per-cell comments).

mdFile.description: markdown: path to a local .md file to load + render instead of inline "md" (e.g. view a README/plan/report). Resolved against the CWD. Quick view of one or more files: `rly view a.md b.md`.

code.description: mermaid: diagram source (e.g. "graph TD; A-->B"); plantuml: the @startuml…@enduml source; code: the source to display (syntax-highlighted with line numbers).

codeFile.description: code: path to a local source file to load + display instead of inline "code". Resolved against the CWD; lang defaults from the file extension.

filename.description: code/diff/git-conflict: optional file name/path shown as a header label above the block.

editable.description: mermaid: when true, render an "Edit diagram" toggle so the user can edit the diagram source live. The edited source is returned in result.blockEdits[<blockId>].

dot.description: graphviz: DOT source (e.g. "digraph { a -> b }"). Rendered offline via vendored Viz.js; nodes and edges are individually commentable.

server.description: plantuml: PlantUML server base URL (http(s)). Defaults to https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml. Diagrams render via this server (needs network).

lang.description: code/diff/git-conflict block: language hint for syntax highlighting (js, ts, py, go, rust, java, c, cpp, csharp, ruby, php, swift, kotlin, sql, yaml, json, sh, css, html, …).

diff.description: diff: a unified diff (git diff / diff -u output) — rendered as a colored, line-numbered comparison with +added / −removed / context rows and file/hunk headers. No git needed; just write/paste the diff text.

diffFile.description: diff: path to a local file containing a unified diff (alternative to "diff"). Resolved against the CWD.

view.description: diff: initial layout — "unified" (default, one column) or "split" (side-by-side old vs new). The viewer also has a live toggle either way.

review.description: diff: when true, render per-hunk Apply / Skip / Hold controls and return choices in result.blockEdits[blockId] as {type:"diff-review", hunks:{...}}. Used by `rly git cherry-pick --code`.

reviewKind.description: diff review: optional label for the review workflow, such as "cherry-pick" or "pick".

commit.description: diff review: optional commit SHA associated with this diff.

express.description: a2ui: a live widget in A2UI Express, e.g. `$/jobs = [{title:"Build",tone:"ok"}]` then `root = Card("CI", [List($/jobs), Button("Retry", action=Event("retry"))])`. Compiled by the A2UI SDK against Relay's catalog (run `rly a2ui` for the grammar and every component). Button events, input values come back in result.blockEdits[blockId] as {type:"a2ui", data, events}.

components.description: a2ui: the same widget as flat A2UI v1.0 JSON components (root id "root", a Card) instead of "express".

dataModel.description: a2ui: the data model for "components" (use `$/path = value` lines with "express" instead).

content.description: git-conflict: inline file content containing conflict markers (<<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>>). The board auto-detects each hunk and returns resolutions in result.blockEdits[blockId].

file.description: git-conflict: local conflicted file path to load, parse, and resolve. Resolved against the CWD.

path.description: git-conflict: alias for local conflicted file path.

config.description: chart: a full Chart.js config object.

series.description: chart shorthand: [{label, data:[...], color?}]. Chart data points are individually commentable.

title.description: chart shorthand: chart title. video: title/caption shown under the player.

columns.description: table: strings, or {key, label, align?}. Cells are commentable.

rows.description: table: array of arrays (positional) or array of objects (keyed by column key).

rowsFile.description: table: load rows from a local .csv/.tsv/.json file instead of inline "rows". CSV/TSV first row is the header (becomes "columns" if omitted); JSON is an array of objects. Resolved against the CWD. Quick view: `rly view data.csv`.

filterable.description: table: show a filter box that live-filters rows by substring across all cells. Good for large tables.

exportable.description: table: show a "CSV" button that downloads the (filtered) rows as a CSV file.

html.description: html: custom markup rendered in a sandboxed iframe.

htmlFile.description: html: path to an HTML file (alternative to "html").

src.description: image: http(s)/data URL, or a local file path (png/jpg/gif/webp/svg/avif/bmp — embedded at spec time, served offline). video: a YouTube/Vimeo URL (embeds an iframe player), an http(s) media URL, or a local video file (mp4/webm/ogv/mov/mkv/m4v — streamed from the server, never embedded).

alt.description: image: alt text / annotation label. video: accessible title for the player.

palettes.description: palette: one or more color palettes to display as swatch cards. Each swatch reveals its hex on hover and copies it on click; mark one {featured:true} to show it as a larger spotlight. Each item: {name?, sub? (or mood?), tag? (or badge?), tagTone? (warm|cool|neutral|nature|bold|digital), featured?, colors:[…]}.

colors.description: palette shorthand: colors for a single palette (use "palettes" for several named ones). Pairs with block-level "name".

name.description: palette shorthand: name for the single "colors" palette.

items.description: kpi: stat cards. Each {label, value, delta?, dir? (up|down|flat — tints the delta), sub?}. Big-number metrics at a glance ("Revenue $1.2M ↑12%") with no chart.

specimens.description: typography: type specimens rendered at the given style. Each {label?, size? (e.g. "32px"/"2rem"), weight? (e.g. "600"), font?, lineHeight?, letterSpacing?, text?}. Block-level "font" sets a default family.

ref.description: Any block: a stable name (e.g. "velocity") that a markdown reference link [see chart](#ref:velocity) can open in a full-screen modal — so a question can point back to a visual shown earlier instead of making the user scroll up.

pins.description: image: enable coordinate pin-comments — the user clicks any point on the image to drop a comment anchored to that spot (Figma-style), returned as a {kind:"image-point", x, y} annotation.

before.description: compare: the "before" image — an http(s)/data URL, a local file path, or {src, label}.

after.description: compare: the "after" image — an http(s)/data URL, a local file path, or {src, label}.

beforeLabel.description: compare: caption for the before side (default "Before").

afterLabel.description: compare: caption for the after side (default "After").

height.description: Block height in px. Defaults: chart 320, html 360; markdown/table/code flow naturally; mermaid/graphviz/plantuml natural (max 800, scrolls; set a larger height to override); image/compare natural.

html.description: Legacy: board-level custom HTML. Normalized into a single html block PREPENDED to "blocks".

htmlFile.description: Legacy: path to an HTML file (alternative to "html"). Resolved against the CWD. Normalized into a prepended html block.

htmlHeight.description: Legacy: iframe height for the html/htmlFile block.

allowPartial.description: When true, users may submit with unanswered questions (returned in "skipped").

note.description: Show an optional free-text note box ("Anything else?") returned as "comment".

autoClose.description: Try to close the browser tab automatically after submit.

responseRequired.description: Set false for a display-only board: no questions, note box, comments, or Submit/Acknowledge action are shown, and the presenting agent should continue immediately.

submitLabel.description: Submit button label. Defaults: "Submit", or "Acknowledge" when there are no questions.

id.description: Answer key in the result JSON. Defaults to q1, q2, …

options.description: For single/multi/rank/checklist/allocate. Strings, or {value, label, description, blocks?}. An option's "blocks" render INSIDE that option card — use them to show each choice (image/chart/mermaid/html…) instead of describing it in words. "rank": user reorders (drag/↑↓), answer is the ordered values, ≥2 options. "checklist": each option gets a status (see "statuses"), answer is {value: status}. "allocate": user distributes "total" across options, answer is {value: number}.

blocks.description: Visuals for THIS option, rendered inside its card. Same block types as everywhere else. Keep them compact (height ~140–260).

items.description: pick only: the tiles to choose among, 1 to 60. Strings, or {id, title, image?, video?, url?, caption?}. "image" is an https/data URL or a local file (embedded); "video" is an https YouTube/Vimeo link or media URL, shown as a link or a muted preview; "url" opens a page. The answer is {picks:[{id, note?}], overall?}: ids in the order picked, a note per tile, one overall note.

id.description: Answer key for this tile (default: its title).

image.description: https/data URL, or a local image file (embedded).

video.description: https YouTube/Vimeo link or media file URL.

url.description: https page the tile links to.

itemNote.description: pick only: a note field on each picked tile. Set false to hide it.

overall.description: pick only: one overall note under the tiles. Set false to hide it.

other.description: Add a free-text "Other" option (a multi-line textarea); its text is returned verbatim as the value. Defaults ON for "single" (radio) questions so the user is never boxed in — set other:false to remove it; "multi" stays opt-in (other:true).

note.description: Small optional free-text field under the question (to qualify an answer). Returned separately as result.notes[questionId]. Defaults to true for the decision types — single, rank, checklist, allocate — so users can qualify their pick; false for other types. Set note:false to hide it, note:true to add it.

default.description: Pre-selected value. Shape matches the answer shape for the type.

min.description: scale: lowest value. pick: fewest tiles to pick (default 0; 1 or more makes the question required).

max.description: scale: highest value, at most 10. pick: most tiles to pick (default: all of them; 1 makes it a single choice).

presets.description: color only: optional small preset swatches (CSS colors) shown beside the native picker for one-click selection. The answer is returned as a color string.

palette.description: color only: a "pick from a palette" of labeled swatch CARDS — each click selects that color as the answer, and each card is individually commentable (per-color feedback). Items: a CSS color string (hex/rgb/hsl/named — multiple color systems supported via the browser, no library), or {value (or color), label?}. The native picker stays available for a custom color.

statuses.description: checklist only: the per-item statuses (default Pass / Fail / N/A). Strings, or {value, label, tone?} where tone ∈ ok|bad|muted|warn tints the chip. Answer is a map {optionValue: statusValue} for the items the user set.

total.description: allocate only: the budget to distribute across options (default 100). Answer is a map {optionValue: number}.

unit.description: allocate only: optional unit label shown next to the total (e.g. "%", "pts", "hrs").

blocks.description: Rich content blocks rendered in order. Board-level blocks show above the questions; per-question blocks show above the control. Each is annotatable (element-level comments returned in result.annotations).

annotations.description: Returned in the result (not part of the input spec). Element-level comments the user attached to blocks. Each: {id, questionId|null, blockId|null, target:{kind:"chart-element"|"mermaid-node"|"graphviz-node"|"table-cell"|"text"|"html-element"|"image", …}, text, createdAt}. For html-element, target carries a stable ref + label; users can hover any element of a custom-HTML block (automatic) or ones the author marked with data-relay-annotate.

blockEdits.description: Returned in the result (not part of the input spec). A map blockId→edited block payload. Editable mermaid blocks return edited source strings. git-conflict blocks return {type:"git-conflict-resolution", resolutions, content, resolved, filename, file}. diff review blocks return {type:"diff-review", hunks, resolved, commit}. a2ui blocks return {type:"a2ui", data (the widget data model with the user input values), events:[{name, context, at}] (each button click, in order)}. null when the user made no edits.
